stem: Which line best explains why the speaker begins to speak at the end of the poem but then stops?

options.label: A
options.text: A clap of thunder beyond those hills.

options.label: B
options.text: it hits me that my daughter is a young woman,

options.label: C
options.text: the russet and gold of late summer’s sunburnt grasses,

options.label: D
options.text: That’s the trick in life—learning to leave well enough alone.
